name: 62205 · E Saint Louis, IL
findings: ZIP 62205 (E Saint Louis) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62205 (E Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62205 (E Saint Louis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
